findings.text: §15's deliverable introduces two independent exemptions (an observed session's rows, keyed on the observed set threaded from `follower_row_path`; and the own session's `starting → working` start, keyed on widening `_is_own_start` beyond `("dispatched","working")`), but its only declared negative control "drops the observed-session delivery" and checks `test_follow_observes_other_sessions.py`, which exercises the observed half alone; a node could ship the own-start widening as a no-op and this control would still pass, so the second mechanism has no declared control showing it fires
